page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Four numbered theses (LXXXIX, XC, XCI, XCII), each as one paragraph with an italic citation at its end. No margin notes, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: LXXXIX.
Cœlestium verborum simplicitate pro vo-
luntatis suæ sensu, non pro veritatis ipsius
absolutione susceperunt aliter interpretanda,
quàm dictorum virtus postularet. De intelli-
gentia enim hæresis, non de Scriptura est,
& sensus non sermo sit crimen. lib. 2.
XC.
Videntur sibi de singulis quæ asserunt præ-
stare rationem, quia singulis assertionibus suis
quædam ex divinis voluminibus testimonia
subdiderunt, quæ corrupto intelligentiæ sen-
su solis tantum[?] ignorantibus blandiantur, spe-
ciem veritatis secundum prauitatem interpre-
tantium præstitura. lib. 4.
XCI.
Grauis & periculosus est error in plurimis,
& multorum lapsus: etiamsi se intelligat, ta-
men exurgendi pudore autoritatem sibi præsu-
mit, ex numero habens hoc impudentiæ, ut
quod errat, prudentiā velit existimari: & quod
cum multis errat, intelligentiam esse asserat
veritatis, dum minus erroris esse existimatur in
multis. lib. 6.
XCII.
Incredibilibus se corrupti ingenii artibus
hæretica subtilitas circumegit: primùm ut
fingeret religionem, deinde ut omnium sim-
plicium aurium securitate verbis falleret, tum
præterea ut se prudentiæ sæculi coaptaret, po-
stremò ut veritatis intelligentiam per speciem[?]

page.notes: The page number reads "9ƒ", taken as 91; the long s is rendered as s throughout. Last line is cut at the lower edge of the scan, so "speciem" is uncertain. "tantum" is uncertain (may read "tantium"). The hyphenated "præ-stare" and "sim-plicium" are line-end breaks with printed hyphens. Printing errors are left as printed.
